headline: Correction: Arhan canli’s 24th-place climb is outside gold

sections.text: A wire story published earlier today misstated Arhan canli’s medal position. Arhan climbed from 826th to 24th at 43.33 (+12.77), outside the 15 ARC-2 gold places.
